properties.name: Filter
properties.acceptedValues: Pairs of description and pattern separated by |; an uneven number of parts throws ArgumentException
properties.description: Defines the file types in the type list.
properties.usage: Offer only the file types your program can open.
properties.expectedEffect: The type list shows the two entries.

properties.name: FilterIndex
properties.description: The entry of the type list selected at start.
properties.usage: Preselect the type your users use most.
properties.expectedEffect: The second filter is selected.

properties.name: InitialDirectory
properties.description: The folder the dialog opens in.
properties.usage: Start in the user's documents folder.
properties.expectedEffect: The dialog opens in My Documents.

properties.name: Multiselect
properties.description: Lets the user choose more than one file.
properties.usage: Import several files at once.
properties.expectedEffect: Ctrl and Shift selection become possible; read FileNames afterwards.

properties.name: FileName
properties.acceptedValues: A file name or full path
properties.description: The name of the selected file.
properties.usage: Read the file that was chosen.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the full path after the user clicks Open.

properties.name: FileNames
properties.description: All selected files.
properties.usage: Process every chosen file.
properties.expectedEffect: Enumerates each selected path.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: The text in the title bar of the dialog.
properties.usage: Say what the user is opening.
properties.expectedEffect: The dialog shows your title.

properties.name: CheckFileExists
properties.description: Warns when the typed file name does not exist.
properties.usage: Allow new names by setting it to false.
properties.expectedEffect: A warning appears for names that do not exist.

properties.name: Filter
properties.acceptedValues: Pairs of description and pattern separated by |
properties.description: Defines the file types in the type list.
properties.usage: Offer the formats you can write.
properties.expectedEffect: The type list shows the CSV entry.

properties.name: DefaultExt
properties.acceptedValues: An extension without the dot, such as "txt"
properties.description: The extension appended when the user types none (with AddExtension).
properties.usage: Make sure saved files have a proper extension.
properties.expectedEffect: A name typed as report becomes report.csv.

properties.name: FileName
properties.acceptedValues: A file name or full path
properties.description: The suggested and the chosen file name.
properties.usage: Suggest a name and read the result.
properties.expectedEffect: The name box starts with report.csv.

properties.name: OverwritePrompt
properties.description: Asks for confirmation before replacing an existing file.
properties.usage: Keep the safety prompt on.
properties.expectedEffect: The user must confirm an overwrite.

properties.name: AddExtension
properties.description: Appends the extension automatically when it is missing.
properties.usage: Turn it off if you add extensions yourself.
properties.expectedEffect: Names without extension get DefaultExt added.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: The text in the title bar of the dialog.
properties.usage: Say what is being saved.
properties.expectedEffect: The dialog shows your title.

properties.name: InitialDirectory
properties.description: The folder the dialog opens in.
properties.usage: Start in the last used folder.
properties.expectedEffect: The dialog opens in that folder.

properties.name: SelectedPath
properties.description: The folder shown at start and the folder the user chose.
properties.usage: Read the chosen folder.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the full path after OK.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: A text shown above the folder tree.
properties.usage: Explain what the folder is used for.
properties.expectedEffect: The text is displayed in the dialog.

properties.name: RootFolder
properties.description: The top of the tree the user can browse. The classic dialog honors it; the modern dialog may ignore it.
properties.usage: Restrict browsing to one area.
properties.expectedEffect: The tree starts at My Documents (classic dialog).

properties.name: ShowNewFolderButton
properties.description: Shows the Make New Folder button in the classic dialog.
properties.usage: Hide the button when only existing folders may be used.
properties.expectedEffect: The button is not shown.

properties.name: UseDescriptionForTitle
properties.description: Uses Description as the title of the modern dialog.
properties.usage: Give the dialog a meaningful title.
properties.expectedEffect: Description appears in the title bar.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: The color shown at start and the color the user chose.
properties.usage: Read the chosen color.
properties.expectedEffect: The button takes the chosen color after OK.

properties.name: AllowFullOpen
properties.description: Lets the user open the custom color section.
properties.usage: Turn it off to allow only the basic palette.
properties.expectedEffect: The Define Custom Colors button is disabled.

properties.name: FullOpen
properties.description: Opens the custom color section when the dialog appears. AllowFullOpen must be true.
properties.usage: Start with the full color picker.
properties.expectedEffect: The dialog opens fully expanded.

properties.name: CustomColors
properties.acceptedValues: An array of up to 16 colors in OLE format (BGR)
properties.description: The colors shown in the custom color boxes.
properties.usage: Offer your brand colors.
properties.expectedEffect: Orange appears in the custom colors.

properties.name: AnyColor
properties.description: Shows all available basic colors.
properties.usage: Offer a larger palette.
properties.expectedEffect: More colors appear in the basic palette.

properties.name: SolidColorOnly
properties.description: Restricts the choice to solid colors.
properties.usage: Avoid dithered colors on low-color displays.
properties.expectedEffect: Only solid colors can be chosen.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: The font shown at start and the font the user chose.
properties.usage: Apply the chosen font to a control.
properties.expectedEffect: The control uses the chosen font after OK.

properties.name: Color
properties.acceptedValues: Any Color (only when ShowColor is true)
properties.description: The text color the user chose.
properties.usage: Let users choose the font color too.
properties.expectedEffect: The text takes the chosen color.

properties.name: ShowColor
properties.description: Shows the color list in the dialog.
properties.usage: Allow choosing a color together with the font.
properties.expectedEffect: A Color drop-down appears in the dialog.

properties.name: ShowEffects
properties.description: Shows the Strikeout and Underline check boxes.
properties.usage: Hide them when you do not support them.
properties.expectedEffect: The effect check boxes are hidden.

properties.name: MaxSize
properties.description: The largest point size that can be chosen.
properties.usage: Prevent unreasonably large text.
properties.expectedEffect: Sizes above 48 are not accepted.

properties.name: MinSize
properties.description: The smallest point size that can be chosen.
properties.usage: Prevent unreadable text.
properties.expectedEffect: Sizes below 8 are not accepted.

properties.name: FontMustExist
properties.description: Shows an error when the user types a font that is not installed.
properties.usage: Avoid unknown fonts.
properties.expectedEffect: An error message appears for fonts that do not exist.
